questions.qtext:
Consider the following statements:
1. A cantilever sheet pile derives its stability from lateral resistance of soil.
2. Wall friction on retaining wall reduces the passive earth pressure and increases active earth pressure.
3. Rankine’s earth pressure theory is simplified version of Coulomb’s earth pressure theory.
Which of he above statements are correct?
questions.solution:
(c)
Wall friction on retaining wall reduces the active earth pressure and increases passive earth pressure.

questions.qtext: Which of the following statement is incorrect regarding capillary pressure in the soil?

options.text: Effective stress increases due to capillary zone.
Pore water pressure is negative in capillary zone.

Water is under tension in capillary zone.

questions.solution:
(c)
Capillary pressure is more in fine grained soils.

questions.qtext: If the base period of a 4-hour unit hydrograph of a basin is 76 hours, then a 12 hour unit hydrograph derived from this 4 hour unit hydrograph will have a base period of
questions.solution:
(b)
The 12 hour unit hydrograph will be obtained by adding ordinates of 4 hour and ordinates of 4
hour UH lagged by 4 hours consecutively two times. So the base period for 12 hour UH will be 76
+ 4 + 4 = 84 hours.

questions.qtext:
Consider the following statements regarding unit hydrograph:
1. Unit hydrograph theory is not applicable to catchment areas larger than 5000 sq. km.
2. Effective rainfall is uniformly distributed within its duration.
3. Unit hydrograph theory assumes linear response and linear time variance.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.solution:
(b)
Unit hydrograph theory assumes time invariance and linear response.
